paragraphs: Hillel ben Gamliel — see his entry.
Rabbi Chanina ben Gamliel — Kiddushin, chapter 3, mishnah 4. Yehuda ben Gamliel is Rabbi Yehuda Nesiah, and there were three of them, as explained in their entries.
Rabbi Shimon ben Gamliel — there were two of them; see their entries.

notes.text: Hyman distinguishes three bearers of the Yehudah Nasi name and two of Shimon ben Gamliel; these are the notice’s own enumerations.
